cabinDoor.name: The Cabin Door
cabinDoor.description: Through the purposely cut holes of the wooden door you can see moonlight

cabinDesk.name: The Desk
cabinDesk.description: It's a dust covered desk, clearly it hasn't been used in ages

cabinFireplace.name: The Fireplace
cabinFireplace.description: A bright fireplace illuminates the immediate surroundings. You notice a few lightsources

cabinShelves.name: The Shelves
cabinShelves.description: Shelves upon shelves, boxes upon boxes, "a hourder's dream," you thought to yourself

clearing.name: Empty Clearing
clearing.description: You now stand in a moonlit clearing, with nothing but your trusty lantern, time to take a step of faith

riddleOne.name: Triple Forking Path
riddleOne.description: Now in a dense forest, You stand between 3 diverging paths, you notice a sign in the middle

riddleOne200.description: After traversing a while, you realise you hit a dead end

riddleOne113.description: After traversing a while, you realise you hit a dead end

riddleOne84.description: You notice a sign in the middle of the road, it has a very noticable smiley face on it

riddleTwo.name: Second Forking Path

riddleThree.description: You once again, once again stand between 3 diverging paths, you start getting frustrated and hope there's new mechanics after this

theCampfire.name: The Camp Fire
theCampfire.description: You find a lonely camp, aside from a booming campfire, you also notice many other supplies

theRiver.name: River
theRiver.description: Across a raging river, you notice a bright light

thePlayground.name: Playground
thePlayground.description: You stand at the entrance of a playground, it's very hard to not notice the long pair of legs next to you

merryGoround.name: Merry-Go-Round
merryGoround.description: A Merry-Go-Round, not exactly the most exciting thing

slide.name: Slide
slide.description: A slide, it's too dark, and someting wet is on the steps so, no thanks

jungleGym.name: Jungle Gym
jungleGym.description: A large net of thick ropes, impossible to get in, or out, so why is there a key inside...

monkeyBars.name: Monkey Bars
monkeyBars.description: You notice a shovel in the middle of the monkey bars, unfortunately you're still only able to do 2-3 so...

sandBox.name: Sandbox
sandBox.description: "Pirates hide their treasure in the sand!" ...Atleast that's what Kris used to say, you miss him

theOrchard.name: The Orchard
theOrchard.description: Across groves of dead apple trees, only one remains, it stares at you eagerly

theExit.name: The Exit
theExit.description: After tials and tribulations, you can finally leave... You also wondered how you never actually used the word "tribulations" before

falling.name: The End?
falling.description: As you stepped through the door you suddenly find yourself in freefall, you life begins to flash before your eyes as the floor gets closer and closer

bedroom.name: KEEP FALLING
bedroom.description: You suddenly lay awake in your bed at home, you can feel a huge wave of relief as you realise it was all a dream, however you can hear a knock on the door

finalDoor.name: Door
finalDoor.description: You now stand in a moonlit clearing, with nothing but your trusty lantern, you realise you're still in a dream

template.description: Through the purposely cut holes of the wooden door you can see moonlight

flesh-cube.name: Flesh Cube
flesh-cube.description: It's a cube made of flesh. "It's rude to stare you know?"

tupperware.name: Tupperware Bowl... Thing
tupperware.description: No matter how hard you wash it you can still see and smell hints of spahgetti on it

netStrings.name: Jungle Gym Strings
netStrings.description: Behind all the strings you can see a small key

high-shovel.name: Shovel
high-shovel.description: A shovel is just out of reach

sand.name: Sand
sand.description: It's too much to dig with your hands, you need a bigger scoop

darkMass.name: Dark Block, thing
darkMass.description: Ypon closer inspection, looks like a rock!

cbox1.description: Just a box, maybe look inside it?

riddle1Sign.name: Wooden Sign
riddle1Sign.description: It asks "Two pairs of die with two 2s, two 4s, and two 6s on all sides, if rolled 10 times, what is the only possible sum?"

riddle2Sign.name: Wooden Sign
riddle2Sign.description: "There are 3 rooms, one contains a deadly spike pit, one contains two hungry lions that haven't eaten in weeks, and another contains swinging blades, which room should you go through?"

riddle3Sign.name: Wooden Sign
riddle3Sign.description: "Okay here's an easy one, go through the path that is equal to 3!"

riddle1RightSign.name: Wooden Sign
riddle1RightSign.description: "Correct! The max possible is 120, so it can't be 200, and since it's all even numbers it can't be 113, which leaves 84!"

riddle2RightSign.name: Wooden Sign
riddle2RightSign.description: "Correct! Because lions that haven't eaten in weeks would be dead!"

riddle3RightSign.name: Wooden Sign with a smiley face

apple.name: Apple
apple.description: A honeycrisp red apple, your brother's favorite

cabinBook.name: Dusty Book
cabinBook.description: After dusting it off, you notice the back says "Spare Key in Box 4"

scribbled-notes.name: Dirty Notebook
scribbled-notes.description: "Jimmy went North and said he'd return if he couldn't find the exit, it's been a few hours, I think he figured it out"

wet-note.name: Hastily Written Damp Note
wet-note.description: "God damn it all, that long legs grabbed my helmet and tank, I have no idea where he went but this is my only shot at leaving"

redKey.name: Red Key
redKey.description: It's a red key, das it :|

cabinKey.name: Key
cabinKey.description: A gold key that has an odd smell, it must be the spare for the cabin door

blueFirstHalfKey.name: The Bow of Orchard Key
blueFirstHalfKey.description: It looks like 1 half of a whole key, neat

blueSecondHalfKey.name: The Blade of Orchard Key
blueSecondHalfKey.description: It looks like 1 half of a whole key, neat

blueKey.name: Orchard Key
blueKey.description: Seems like you can use this to unlock the Orchard gate

lantern.name: Lantern
lantern.description: It's a lantern, seems to still work

slingshot.name: Empty Slingshot
slingshot.description: A cool slingshot, too bad you don't have anything to shoot

rock.name: Rock
rock.description: A small rock, seems like the perfect ammo source

divingBody.name: Diving Outfit
divingBody.description: An imcomplete diving suit, seems like it's missing the head and tanks

divingHelmet.name: Diving Helmet and Tanks
divingHelmet.description: A huge helmet and air tanks, but with nothing to secure on

divingSuit.name: Diving Suit
divingSuit.description: A complete diving suit, seems like it can get you ro the end

shovel.name: Shovel
shovel.description: "Their all scattered in graves, here I go"

fireplace.name: Fireplace
fireplace.description: It's a warm fireplace, seems like you can refuel your lantern here
